title: vote.close
description: host → server. The host ends the current stage now (skip button, teacher control). REVEAL, PREDICT and INSPECT move to the next stage; VOTE and RUNOFF close and resolve with the ballots present (closedBy = HOST); TIEBREAK stages fall through to the next tie-breaker; RESULT moves to CLOSED.

RoundId.description: Vote round identifier chosen by the host; unique within the room for its whole lifetime.
